# Bible Atlas

> Read the Bible with context. Bible Atlas is a free, public web app that pairs the
> full 66-book Bible with interactive maps, journeys, timelines, a concordance and
> thematic connections between passages. No sign-up required; every page is public
> and server-rendered HTML.

Site: https://mybibleatlas.com

## Main pages

- [Bible reader (home)](https://mybibleatlas.com/): read any book, chapter and verse
- [About Bible Atlas](https://mybibleatlas.com/about): what the product is, screenshots, FAQ
- [Interactive Bible maps](https://mybibleatlas.com/journeys): hub of journey maps
- [Abraham's journey](https://mybibleatlas.com/journeys/abraham)
- [Paul's missionary journeys](https://mybibleatlas.com/journeys/paul)
- [Bible timeline](https://mybibleatlas.com/timeline)
- [Concordance](https://mybibleatlas.com/concordance): word study across the KJV
- [Connections](https://mybibleatlas.com/connections): themes traced across Scripture
- [What's new](https://mybibleatlas.com/whats-new)

## URL patterns

- Book: `https://mybibleatlas.com/{book}` — e.g. /genesis, /john
- Chapter: `https://mybibleatlas.com/{book}/{chapter}` — e.g. /john/3
- Verse: `https://mybibleatlas.com/{book}/{chapter}/{verse}` — e.g. /john/3/16
- Concordance term: `https://mybibleatlas.com/concordance/{term}` — e.g. /concordance/faith
- Connection node: `https://mybibleatlas.com/connections/{node}`

Full URL list: https://mybibleatlas.com/sitemap.xml

## Translations

Public-domain translations only: KJV (default), WEB, ASV, YLT and several
non-English editions. Licensed translations (NIV, NKJV, AMP) are not included.

## Not for crawling

- /admin/ — private administration pages
- /highlights — device-local personal data
